title: Google could take stake in bitcoin miner TeraWulf’s $19 billion AI project if Anthropic defaults
reason: Major infrastructure deal involving Google, Anthropic, and a Bitcoin miner with unusual financial provisions.

sources.summary: A $19 billion data-center agreement includes an unusual provision allowing Google to acquire part of the project if Anthropic fails to pay its rent.

title: Binance hackers had 8 weeks of access before $6.3B exploit, Security Alliance estimates
reason: Major security breach details revealing 8 weeks of access, significantly impacting trust in exchange security.

sources.summary: The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.
